prompt: Explain why multi-factor authentication improves account security.
candidate_answer: Multi-factor authentication adds another verification factor beyond a password. It reduces risk but does not guarantee complete security. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/multi-factor-authentication-mfa

prompt: State whether a vulnerability is always critical when it has a high CVSS score.
candidate_answer: A high CVSS score alone does not establish business criticality; exploitability, exposure, asset importance, and compensating controls also matter.
